description: Frozen showcase (docs/architecture/DECISIONS.md): the backends under api/** get no routine updates, only
vulnerability fixes and base-image digest refreshes, grouped per backend and auto-merged when that backend's CI
(its own tests plus the conformance suite against its image) is green. Everything else (web/, pipeline/,
contracts/, edge/, GitHub Actions) keeps Renovate's normal policy.
How the override works: vulnerabilityAlerts is applied as a final packageRule with force, so enabled: true
re-enables a dependency the api/** rule disabled, but only for the vulnerable version range.

vulnerabilityAlerts.groupName: {{#if additionalBranchPrefix}}{{{replace '/' '' additionalBranchPrefix}}} backend security fixes{{else}}{{{depName}}} vulnerability{{/if}}

packageRules.description: Frozen showcase: no routine version updates for any backend (dependencies, toolchains, base images).
Base images: a new digest for the same pinned tag is a patched rebuild (OS and JRE/Node CVE fixes).
One security PR per backend, auto-merged only after the backend's tests and conformance pass.
